items.question: How many suggestions from the public did Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid receive during the UAE's 2013 national brainstorming session on health and education?
items.gold: He received 65,000 suggestions from the public.
items.fact: Sheikh Mohammed received 65,000 public suggestions on health and education

items.question: Which UAE federal law regulates the possession and trade of predatory, dangerous and semi-dangerous animals?
items.fact: Federal Law No. 22 of 2016 regulates dangerous and exotic animal possession
